author: fluxor
description: Create messages table for chat history
up: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('user', 'assistant', 'system')), content TEXT NOT NULL, timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_session ON messages(session_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_timestamp ON messages(timestamp)
